title: Wanderburg Switch: Is There a Nintendo Switch Version?
description: Is Wanderburg on Nintendo Switch? We check official sources for a confirmed Switch version, current platforms, and how to follow future news.
h1: Is Wanderburg Coming to Nintendo Switch?

sections.h2: Is There a Confirmed Switch Version?
paragraphs: As of the latest public information, Wanderburg is listed on Steam for PC. No Nintendo Switch version has been confirmed through the developers' official channels.
There is no official announcement of a Switch port, so any claim of a guaranteed Switch release should be treated with caution until the team confirms it.
The Steam store page shows the game's current platform availability, and the official site and Discord are where the team shares news. None of these channels currently announce a Switch edition.
Because no console roadmap naming the Switch has been published, the status stays unconfirmed — sources on this topic are thin, and new information is not yet available.

sections.h2: How to Stay Updated on Switch News
paragraphs: The most reliable way to track a possible Switch version is to follow the official Discord and revisit the roadmap and release-date pages as they are updated.
While waiting for platform news, players can try the Steam demo and use the guide to learn the basics of the game.

note: Switch release status is unconfirmed as of the latest public sources; no Switch date or version has been officially announced.
